items.title: Glueing finitely many one-dimensional semi-local rings inside a field into a single semi-local domain
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file varieties.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma constructs, from finitely many one-dimensional Noetherian semi-local subrings A_i of a field K with A_i tensor A_j mapping onto K for i not equal to j, a Noetherian semi-local domain A inside all of them such that the spectra of the A_i are open subschemes covering Spec(A) with each closed point lying in exactly one of them. The proof takes A to be the intersection of the A_i, derives property (3) from the surjectivity hypothesis by noting that a common closed point would force A_i tensor A_j -> K to land in A_m, and then proves (1) and (2) by induction on r, applying the two-sided semi-local lemma to A = A_1 cap B where B is the intersection of the remaining rings (proof lines 7524-7533). H2: the intersection construction together with the induction through the two-sided lemma is the substance.
